source: វិធានការចម្រុះគ្រប់គ្រងដំណាំ លើដំណាំស្រូវ (Integrated Pest Management on Rice), training slide deck, Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Battambang province, presented by Ms. Yem Sophy, Oct 20, 2017 (contact: ysophy168@gmail.com, 012 558 312)
text: Reference list of major weed species named (Khmer common name plus scientific name) in the rice-field weed identification section of the deck: Cyperus difformis, Cyperus iria, Cyperus rotundus, Digitaria ciliaris, Echinochloa colona, Echinochloa crus-galli (barnyard grass), Eleusine indica, Fimbristylis miliacea, Ipomoea aquatica (water spinach -- a common wet-field weed that is also an edible vegetable), Ischaemum rugosum, Leptochloa chinensis, Monochoria vaginalis, and Sphenochlea zeylanica. These are shown as photo-identification reference material (paired field photos and close-ups of flower/seed heads) without individual control recommendations attached in this section; for control guidance see the herbicide and cultural-control entries from the other sources in this batch.
